notes: Deprecated on 2026-10-08. The gemini-3.5-flash endpoint is not shutting down; Gemini API requests are automatically routed to gemini-3.6-flash. The original model ID and historical price records remain preserved, but those historical rates must not be treated as proof of the routed request's settlement price. V1 stores Standard input, context-cache, and output prices plus Batch input/output prices. Batch context caching is $0.075 per 1M tokens. Google also lists Flex and Priority tiers; those tiers are not represented in V1 pricing fields.
